runtime: ESM on Node >=24.12.0 <25, except the type-only /read entry (no Node runtime required).

..authority: This aggregate entry includes pure helpers and explicit Node-backed persistence, execution, and workspace APIs. Mutation authority is never ambient and remains visible in each signature.
..summary: Complete supported package surface preserved for existing consumers.
..title: Root

./canonical.authority: Pure canonical encoding and identity operations; no filesystem, process, network, persistence, or mutation authority.
./canonical.title: Canonical

./cli.authority: The reusable runner uses caller-supplied I/O and command arguments. Command-specific filesystem or persistence authority remains explicit in those arguments.
./cli.summary: Reusable command-line runner and injectable I/O contract.
./cli.title: CLI

./effects.authority: Handlers are caller-supplied in-process callbacks. Dispatch is non-durable and grants no trace, workspace, interception, replay, or sandbox authority.
./effects.summary: Immutable effect records, correlation, and ordered in-process dispatch.
./effects.title: Effects

./providers.authority: Provider authority is supplied explicitly by the consumer. The deterministic static adapter owns no credentials, network access, execution, or workspace authority.
./providers.summary: Provider-neutral contracts and deterministic static-provider fixtures.
./providers.title: Providers

./read.authority: Type-only readonly trace data; no runtime exports, validation, transport, storage, mutation, or authorization. Installed declarations compile without Node types; the ESM module has no runtime dependencies.
./read.summary: Web-safe semantic records, owner occurrences, cut addresses, slices, and anchors.
./read.title: Read

./runs.authority: Execution requires caller-supplied task and provider authority; durable operations additionally require an explicit trace-store handle. No ambient provider, persistence, or workspace authority is created.
./runs.summary: Run construction, control, execution, recovery, and inspection.
./runs.title: Runs

./tasks.authority: Descriptor and schema helpers are pure. SQLiteTaskRegistry reads or mutates only the caller-selected registry database and must be closed by the caller.
./tasks.summary: Task descriptors, schemas, registry operations, and bounded ledger reads.
./tasks.title: Tasks

./trace.authority: SQLiteTraceStore is explicitly read/write capable for caller-selected storage. Projection helpers remain bounded reads and no workspace authority is created.
./trace.summary: Trace persistence, interchange, integrity, cuts, slices, and bounded evidence queries.
./trace.title: Trace

./workspace.authority: These APIs may read or mutate caller-selected filesystem and Git state, and native runners may launch capability-probed processes. Required task, provider, run, trace, carrier, runner, and grant handles stay explicit.
./workspace.summary: Workspace bindings, custody, grants, placement, retained execution, and exact settlement.
./workspace.title: Workspace
